visual_action: The video opens with a clip of Marco Rubio, wearing a suit, acting as a DJ with headphones on, pointing into the air. The video then cuts to a rapid slideshow of digitally altered still images of Rubio. In these images, he is portrayed as: a TSA agent in uniform holding a metal detector; a person with long blonde hair speaking at a podium; a football coach wearing a Miami Dolphins polo shirt and headset; a person in a full white fur parka and mittens; a hunter in an orange vest and cap holding a shotgun; and a man in a studded leather jacket and light-up headphones.

cast.name: Marco Rubio
cast.evidence: His face is featured in the entire video, both in the initial DJ clip and in a series of digitally manipulated images. The caption also refers to him in his role as 'The Secretary of State'.

cast.name: Miami Dolphins
cast.evidence: The team's logo is visible on the polo shirt Marco Rubio is digitally depicted wearing in one of the images.

on_screen_text.text: The Secretary of State who can do it all

spoken_summary: Over the music, a hype man shouts phrases like, "Give it up for the DJ, let's go!" The song playing has the audible lyrics, "I feel so close to you right now."
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat, energetic electronic dance music track "Feel So Close" by Calvin Harris, creating a positive and hype-filled mood.
editing_pacing: The video starts with a short clip and then transitions into a fast-paced slideshow of still images, with cuts synchronized to the beat of the electronic music.
manipulation_or_satire: Marco Rubio's head is digitally superimposed onto the bodies of people in various costumes and roles, including a TSA agent, a football coach, a hunter, and a punk rocker. One image also digitally gives him long blonde hair. The manipulations are used humorously to illustrate the caption's claim that he 'can do it all.'
cultural_references: Feel So Close by Calvin Harris
central_claim: As Secretary of State, Marco Rubio is a versatile and capable figure who can handle any role or situation.
intended_effect: To portray Marco Rubio in a humorous and positive light, making him seem multi-talented, relatable, and 'cool'.
uncertainty_flags: The text on the t-shirt in the final manipulated image is illegible.
